banner.title: THE LUNG PROMOTION - THE LUNG WANG AND SHEN LUNG DEFS (FF print pp. 28-29: the stat blocks behind the three R818 aquatic lung dragon cross-ref cells, the first FF defs, the ff_print class), the QUEUED-DISCOVERY round - the 3 keyless cells rewire, the registry 810 -> 812, no gap boxes flip - the MM2 arc gap stays 37 closed 0 open
banner.provenance: Round twenty-six of the MM2 arc, the promotion seam round (the lung/shan candidate queued on the landed R820; two defs promoted, the 3 aquatic cells rewired, the walk-key census 189 -> 192)
banner.sentinel: The pin header stays the print-fidelity record; the defs carry the pp. 28-29 stat blocks, the rewire rides the file patches, and the walk cross-checks the defs and the cells live

audit_comment: THE LUNG PROMOTION - the queued R818 discovery closed (the lung dragon cross-ref cells the R818 aquatic walk left keyless): the MM2 index settles the three cells as FF crossrefs (Sea Dragon (Lung Wang), Spirit Dragon (Shan Lung)) - the promotion comes from the FF print, superseding the OA-seam expectation the R818 prose recorded. THE DEFS: the keys lung_wang and shen_lung, the first FF defs in the registry (the new ff_print xp class, the R73 allowed list patched to carry it). The Lung Wang (Sea Dragon) block, FF print p. 28: AC 0, HD 11-13 (the book-average 38), MOVE 3//9 swim, 3 attacks 1-12/1-12/6-36, treasure H(x2), 60 percent lair, level VIII XP 4,550 + 16/hp (the full kill XP 5,158), very intelligence, neutral, size L (up to 30 diameter). The Shen Lung (Spirit Dragon) block, p. 29: AC 1, HD 9-11 (31), MOVE 12/12//9, 4 attacks 1-4/1-4/2-24/1-8, treasure H, 60 percent lair, level VII XP 1,400 + 12/hp (1,772), high intelligence, chaotic neutral, size L (43 long). THE TWO-VOICE SETTLES: the MM2 index OCR reads Shan Lung - the FF print header reads Shen Lung (the chiang lung prose agrees) and Shen wins; the lung wang block OCR reads the bite 5-36 - the prose reads 6-36 and the prose wins. THE REWIRE: the three R818 keyless aquatic cells (CFS die 19 and CSD die 20 sea dragon, RFD die 18 spirit dragon) rekey lung_wang/lung_wang/shen_lung - the src cells stay 0, the R818 source census unchanged; the walk-key census bumps 189 -> 192 (the mm2enca.h const, the R818 audit chain, the walk-key census expression, and the lung row check all ride as file patches, the LungDragonRows const stays 3). THE REGISTRY: 810 -> 812 defs, FF 0 -> 2; the R817-R820 registry-floor consts stand as their own round snapshots. THE DOCTRINE: the lung wang steam cone 100 x 50 up to 3 per day (damage equal to current hit points), the scaly command 4-40 x age level, no water fire, the tribute demand; the shen lung no breath weapon, bless and curse 1 per day each, control weather and ice storm 3 per day each, no lightning damage but double fire damage, water fire 2-12, immune to poison, no insect within 60 feet, manoeuvrability class E, the language shared with the pan lung. NO gap boxes flip this round (the MM2 arc gap stays 37 closed 0 open).
